verdict.rationale: Zoom documents its own interactive way to run the Scribe API: an input console where you can record audio, use a sample conversation, upload a file, or enter a URL, and a live demo for transcribing your own speech. The reference documents endpoints and exposes a machine-readable API catalog via llms.txt. However, nothing shows that the API reference pages themselves are interactive or include runnable code examples. missing for 10: evidence of try-it/runnable examples embedded in the API reference, copyable request/response samples executable against the API, independent hands-on corroboration.
